set.body:
Correct sampling first and implement only general image operations needed by the new objective.

Acceptance gate:
- Fixed and moving images retain independent anti-aliased native pyramids; the moving image is not first resampled onto the fixed output lattice.
- Each level samples both native pyramids through explicit physical maps into a declared virtual work grid.
- Mixed-resolution, anisotropic-spacing, orientation, and oblique-grid analytic linear-field fixtures verify physical-coordinate pulls and gradients.
- Provide reusable separable box sums with a naive reference implementation and explicit boundary semantics. Fast/reference error is bounded in tests by abs <= 1e-10 + 1e-10 * abs(reference) on deterministic Double fixtures.
- Verify the box operator adjoint identity by inner products under every admitted boundary mode.
- Provide padded whole-grid Gaussian and support-normalized convolution using physical sigma per axis, destination-writing APIs, and no registration-specific policy.
- Shared JVM and Scala.js tests pass; allocation and throughput receipts identify whether the implementations are suitable before fusion.
- Gale is unchanged unless profiling exposes a reusable, non-registration-specific missing contract.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G1: native pyramids and reusable image operators
